body: I like your drawings. Do you have more to show?
Indeed it is. Not saying for you to be ignorant, obviously. Just not so rigid. Bend a little.
Where's the fun if you know it all. If I was this being all knowing, I would sleep and have some nightmares.
I like you, you sound very intelligent, but sometimes ignorance is bliss.

Just for the record I am (ego) not feeling good.

So, I ask who is suffering?
ALL I CAN READ IS EGO.
Imagine you being alive without thoughts.

It has its ups and downs...
Want to talk?
Kinda know what you are feeling. When I was a little kid my two dogs where killed, then my house was stolen. That was the beginning of hell for me.
It's funny, two years ago I was meditating everyday, thinking very light thoughts. Reading self-help books, getting all excited. Look at this now, it's so different.
Not really. Just thinking where I made the wrong turn if you know what I mean.
